title: PORTFOLIO CANDID RÜTTER
subtitle: I am a Hamburg/ Bern based Artist working in the field between music composition, theater and media art. This is just a selection of my work. For my full portfolio visit candidruetter.net or download my CV (PDF).

sections.title: music for theater/ dance/ performance

items.title: Engel der Vernichtung
items.text: The music for Engel der Vernichtung functions more like a film score than a traditional theatre soundtrack. Throughout the piece, sound is continuously present, whether through atmospheres, textures, or recurring musical motifs. To meet the demands of a live cinema piece, I developed a technological environment that allows for highly controlled transitions, cuts, and musical changes in real time, with live synchronisation between sound, video, and light.

items.title: hard_break <3
items.text:
HARD_BREAK is a collective breakup ritual that combines elements of karaoke, techno clubs, and rage rooms. Breakups are explored as a performative and choreographic practice: the space becomes a walk-in collage of broken movements, repeated loops, collective destruction, and tender reassembly. Starting from romantic separation, the performance opens up a view of larger, necessary breaks: with toxic patterns, neoliberal imperatives, and the longing for the “good old days.”

To place the piece’s topic at the core of the soundtrack, I drew inspiration from heartbreak songs of the 2000s. I sampled hooks, reworked chord progressions, and distilled their moods and emotional textures. I then contrasted this material with the raw aesthetics of heavy bass and rave music, creating a soundtrack that leaves room for tears, anger, hope, and release.

items.title: GOTT
items.text:
Elisabeth Gärtner no longer wants to live after the death of her husband. The 78-year-old requests a prescription for a lethal medication from her medical officer, Dr Brandt. But the doctor does not want to assist a suicide. She does not think it is right to help a healthy person commit suicide - Mrs Gärtner is not ill and is not suffering from severe pain. In an ethics council, legal, medical and theological experts discuss the case as an example and offer a variety of positions and perspectives on the socially controversial topic of euthanasia. Do people have a right to a self-determined death? Who decides on our death? Who does our life belong to - a god, society, our family or just ourselves?

GOTT is a rather text-heavy, dry, and formal piece. I tried to create music that makes the piece more accessible and engaging, while also add an eerie dimension to it.

sections.text: Since 2022, I have composed the soundtracks for more than ten theatre productions. Visit my website to discover the full list and explore all my work.

items.title: a kind machine
items.text:
A KIND MACHINE is the outcome of a residency at Lichthof Theater Hamburg. I set out to explore the human relationship to technological systems. I developed a method for approaching this question through the dispositions inherent in found objects. Every object is made of different materials, has its own history, and is connected to semiotic systems. What stories can they tell us when we place them together on a stage?

For the showing we created a two-part theater piece that explores this inner world of objects, first through the medium of film, then through live theater. Without any human being on stage, the piece examines how modern technology is influencing our everyday life..

items.title: the meadow
items.text:
The Meadow is a music theatre piece that engages with the eerie qualities of the self-help tools we integrate into our everyday lives.

The Meadow is structured in three parts. Each part tells an iteration of the same story with a different disposition of media.

In the first part, the audience wears blindfolds and is guided by a soothing voice to the meadow, a fictional place of peace and relaxation. It soon becomes clear that this is not the final destination. The story starts over and over again, slowly unraveling the chilling, feverish dream of the protagonist.

Through this formal structure, the piece explores how the presence of different media affects the audience’s experience, and how the viewers’ imagination and memory can be integrated into the compositional strategy.

items.title: holy water
items.text:
Water is the foundation of all life, yet it is also an immensely destructive force. It shapes the living and the non-living alike. It permeates matter and mind, flowing with quiet persistence as it gradually carves its way forward. Water is a hyperobject: we can perceive only fragments of its totality.

HOLY WATER is a speculative, multimedia ritual that approaches the concept of the hyperobject in an atmospheric and associative manner. In a world in which nature is often treated as a stockpile of resources, HOLY WATER seeks to explore alternative frameworks for relating to the natural world and, in doing so, to transform our relationship to it.

Using contact microphones attached to a vessel filled with water, the performer is able to set the water itself into vibration. Inside the vessel, a hydrophone captures and amplifies the sounds produced within the water, creating a feedback loop between the performer and the water vessel.

items.title: terminal infinity
items.text: For Alexander Schubert’s multimedia production Terminal Infinity, I designed the video using the 3D software Blender.

items.title: knäuled
items.text: The light collective Göral and sound designer Candid Rütter have created a 900-meter-long vein of light that meanders seemingly aimlessly through the room. It reacts to visitors in real time and transforms the space into an interactive spectacle. Light pulsates and flickers, sound meets movement and suddenly anything seems possible. Visitors to KNÄULED experience light and sound in a way that was not intended. The installation was part of the Lichtfestival Luzern.

items.title: asterism
items.text:
For the immersive multimedia composition Asterism by Alexander Schubert, Candid did the sound diffusion for the musical composition.

Asterism is a simulation space for possible worlds: virtual, spiritual, dystopian and embracing. In a black hall, accessed through a preparation lock, an extract of reality is constructed – a complete natural copy of a living surrounding. This setting is interwoven with digital and AI-controlled components, which create a space on the border of realities. It investigates the question of how much reduction can be done and still maintain the real – or what are the basic components to construct a spiritual experience. This clash and switching between worlds opens an insight into possible futures of a bio-technical nature in which humans are faced with new conditions. The setting was designed as an immersive experience space to which audience and performers alike were given access for 36 hours.

sections.title: freelancing

items.title: Audiobreeze
items.text: For the company Audiobreeze, I programmed a prototype of their immersive 3D audio system, which creates evolving spatial soundscapes from multichannel nature recordings. My work focused on developing and exploring the technical possibilities of the prototype.

items.title: Sprachenland
items.role: 3D sound diffusion for tracked headphone system
items.text: The exhibition Sprachenland at the Landesmuseum Zürich featured a head-tracking system developed by iart, which calculates a real-time binaural 3D mix for each visitor. As a freelancer, I spatialized all the music within a digital twin of the museum.

sections.text: As a freelancer, I take on projects ranging from sound design and music production to programming and interactive media.

items.title: candid
items.text: Under my first name, I release tracks influenced by a variety of bass-heavy genres, as well as ambient music. This is where I experiment with new ways of shaping and processing sound, exploring different approaches to texture, rhythm, and sonic space.

items.title: PRIX GARANTI
items.text:
We are the voice of our friends, and our friends are the friends of many.

In the face of global events, we believe in local solidarity, in the power of art, lyrics, cohesion, shared feelings, and narratives. Our community is very large and very small. We make music for and against it, we shape dreams, sometimes hymns, accompanying people through summer, winter, and sometimes on the highway.

Style is a means to an end, and we serve and live the stories we sell ourselves.

Since 2021, I have been the producer and bassist of the band Prix Garanti.
